lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all individual change types as each has only been tested once.
Adoption new_flow is the only change type proven helpful so far, securing a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Most round 2 predictions remained too high, though predictions for home new_flow and choose_path layout were too low.

candidates.title: Express Starter Companion Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the adoption selection stage into a streamlined starter companion flow using interactive stage presets.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 36.7% of users and has long duration (median 89s / mean 1017s); prior test evidence shows adoption new_flow is effective.

pick_friend.headline: Pick Your Companion Archetype
pick_friend.body: Select a starter pet style to get up and running instantly.

guard.reason: Allows selecting a pet, preserving the job of pick_friend screen.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with strong past performance (+3.6%) for adoption new_flow.

candidates.title: Redesigned Path Selection Hub
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a centered decision hub showcasing clear companion archetypes side-by-side.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time is 514s due to decision hesitation, and earlier path layout tests performed better than initial predictions.

choose_path.headline: What Kind of Pet Companion Do You Want?
choose_path.body: Choose a desktop buddy tailored for productivity, relaxation, or fun.

guard.reason: choose_path copy loses the required job of offering both adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: Account Sync Protection Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint beneath sign-in options clarifying how sign-in protects pet data across app relaunches.
candidates.why: Top support concern (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in step conversion is 72.9%.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your pet to your cloud account so your pet's state and memory are safe.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in hint without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses top support complaint (8 emails) with low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Calibration Waiting Flow
candidates.change: Transforms the waiting step into a companion trait calibration flow with interactive progress indicators.
candidates.why: Waiting screen has high drop-off and long mean time (2336s); round 2 evidence showed home new_flow outperformed predictions.

waiting.headline: Tuning Your Pet's Desktop Behavior
waiting.body: Adjust companion activity levels while your pet finishes loading.

guard.reason: Maintains the job of showing the pet is being created while allowing interactive calibration.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time; home new_flow previously delivered +2.0% lift.

candidates.title: Split Layout Interaction Showcase
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro finish screen into a split view showing key desktop control hotkeys and pet interaction tips.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion over how to control, hide, or speak to the pet, and 4 noted post-onboarding misbehavior.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!
home_intro.body: Here is how to interact with your pet: right-click for options, drag to move, double-click to chat.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 7 support tickets on pet control, but redesign requires high effort.

candidates.title: Persistent Profile Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign_in screen headline and body text to highlight account syncing as pet backup security.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and 8 support messages report pet loss/reset upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Save & Protect Your Companion
sign_in.body: Create or log into your account so your pet companion stays saved across sessions.

guard.reason: Updates sign_in copy within allowed onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy fix addressing major user data loss concern with high support volume.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Review Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a new summary screen before final certificate generation showing chosen pet traits.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results; providing a confirmation step reduces errors.

adoption_certificate.hint: Review your companion details before completing adoption.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_summary']

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut Quick Hint
candidates.change: Displays an inline helper hint on the finish screen explaining simple pet visibility controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails explicitly asked how to control or hide pets on the desktop after completing onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: You can hide or call your pet anytime using your system tray or double-clicking its icon.

guard.reason: Adds a helper hint to home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Simple config hint targeting desktop pet visibility questions on finish step.

candidates.title: Pet Spawn Wait Estimate Info
candidates.change: Adds progress bar, time estimate, and notification option on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user frustration and churn.

guard.reason: Adds wait progress and notifications on the waiting screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Previous test of home wait_info showed a negative lift (-0.3%).

candidates.title: Companion Path Role Description Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies choose_path options with descriptive copy contrasting active desk buddy versus background focus companion.
candidates.why: choose_path takes mean 514s and drops 23.8% of users due to unclear path differences.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desk Companion Type
choose_path.body: Select whether you want an active interactive friend or a calm background presence.

guard.reason: choose_path copy loses the required job of offering both adopting and making your own.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most individual change types as only adoption new_flow has been tested more than once.
Adoption new_flow and sign_in hint are the only change types with significant wins so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were frequently too high overall, but were underestimated for home new_flow, choose_path layout, and sign_in hint.
